integrity: The count-cumulant and signed-area claims have an analytic proof and a separately executable consistency checker. No physical experiments or independent external review are claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a homogeneous independent Poisson gas, isotropic noise, uniform initial headings and ideal continuum spatially resolved count cumulants; finite-field and finite-sample guarantees and interactions are excluded. General Poisson cumulant identities and one-time chirality moments are established prior work.
title: Chirality is invisible to pair counts but identifiable from three-time count cumulants
